propositions: Jira issue keys change when moved between projects, breaking bindings keyed on the mutable key while the immutable numeric id persists.
Bindings keyed on the stale key can be silently orphaned when the moved_issue_key table fails to update, and the absence probe incorrectly retires live issues.
The fix captures the numeric jira_id alongside the key on every binding, and recovers the binding by id when a key lookup fails, re-keying to the current key.
On a moved issue, the stale key resolves transparently via moved_issue_key; the id fallback is a safety net for the failure mode where that table is not updated.
The additive id-capture approach preserves Cloud behavior, requires no store migration, and is correct under all three readings of what a stale key REST read returns.
